BrochureContent.Content:
Frank V Murphy & Co. are delighted to present this two-bedroom mid-terrace residence ideally located in a highly convenient residential area, just a short walk from Cork City Centre. 

No. 67 High Street presents an excellent opportunity for both first-time buyers and investors seeking a well-located unrestricted rental property. The residence offers a prospective purchaser the chance for further modernisation and personalisation to suit one’s own taste and specification.

To the rear, the property benefits from a private yard with stairs to sun terrace/ decking area which benefits from a south facing aspect. 

The property is located in close proximity to a wide range of local amenities including shops, schools, gorgeous cafés/ food outlets, public transport, South Infirmary Hospital, UCC, and the Douglas Street area.
